title: Embroidered the lost map — finished piece

posts.cooked:
Hey everyone! I finally finished embroidering the lost map from Wayfarer’s Hollow, and I’m so excited to share it here. It’s taken me a few weeks to carefully stitch all the hidden locations and secret paths, especially since I included some of the modded areas from the latest patch. I tried to capture the texture of the old parchment and the faded ink, so it looks like something you’d actually find tucked away in an adventurer’s chest.

One thing I ran into while working on it was a little bug in the compass rose area—some of the directional markers got mixed up on the official map, so I had to guess based on the in-game geography and player notes. I’m thinking maybe this is something the devs could look into? It’s subtle, but it threw me off for a while. Otherwise, stitching those little mountain ranges and river loops was super fun, and I love how the layered fabric gives it a tactile depth that just a flat map wouldn’t have.

Would love to hear if anyone else is working on any creative projects inspired by the game lately! Also, if you want, I’m happy to share close-up photos or even a small tutorial on how I captured the embroidery stitches for the terrain features. This community’s passion for the world of Wayfarer’s Hollow never ceases to inspire me.
